model.architecture: Qwen3.8 target: 64 layers, hidden 5120, 48 GDN and 16 full-attention layers
model.weights: Exact checkpoint tensor identities in each audit result; no requantization

intentional_approximations.weights: E2M1 signed nibble times E8M0 scale per 32 coefficients; low nibble first; exact reconstruction of stored codes
intentional_approximations.activations: OCP E4M3FN dynamic per-token scaling at declared BF16 boundaries
intentional_approximations.kv: OCP E4M3FN with the request's stored FP32 K/V descales; BF16 alternative has a separate storage identity
intentional_approximations.attention: Native full causal attention; no Quest or other sparse selector
intentional_approximations.global512: Separate approximate serving policy. Neither shortlist completeness nor bit-identical reranked scores are certified by this contract. Full vocabulary scoring is used to isolate backbone comparisons.

scalar_rules.bf16_store: Round to nearest, ties to even; retain the signed-zero bit
scalar_rules.fp32: IEEE binary32 rounding after each declared operation; a permitted FMA is one rounding, never silently interchangeable with separate multiply/add
scalar_rules.fp8_store: OCP E4M3FN round to nearest ties even, saturate finite to [-448,448]; FNUZ is a distinct unsupported format
scalar_rules.nonfinite: Nonfinite inputs, intermediates or outputs are explicit qualification failures/unsupported cases, never a successful equality check. This does not claim all production wrappers enforce that condition.
scalar_rules.transcendentals: The exact rsqrt/exp/log1p implementation must be bound to its executable artifact. FP64 mathematical comparisons measure error; they do not establish bit identity with a GPU intrinsic.
scalar_rules.denormals: No blanket flush-to-zero allowance. Per-kernel denormal behavior remains an explicit unproved obligation where not independently checked.

activation_quantization.input: The declared preceding BF16 result widened exactly to FP32
activation_quantization.matmul_input: Exact code reconstruction times the stored FP32 scale
activation_quantization.forbidden: Quantizing an unrounded fused FP32 temporary when the contract requires a BF16 boundary

hidden_normalization.shape: [rows,5120], same row arithmetic for M1, M8 and prefill
hidden_normalization.residual: z=FP32(widen(x)+widen(residual)); carry=BF16_RNE(z); normalization consumes z before carry rounding
hidden_normalization.reduction: 512 logical lanes; four component accumulators per lane; vector indices lane+512*j; FP32 square then add; combine components left-to-right; combine lane groups at offsets 256,128,64,32 then increasing intra-wave offsets 1,2,4,8,16
hidden_normalization.contraction: Disabled for square, accumulation and output multiplies

gdn_gated_normalization.shape: 48 heads of 128 BF16 values per token; BF16 or FP32 scale weights
gdn_gated_normalization.reduction: FP32 square/reduction with the M1 per-head layout: four adjacent components per lane, 32 lanes; preserve this numerical layout when batching rows
gdn_gated_normalization.boundaries: No BF16 cast between normalization, weight multiplication and gating. Exactly one final BF16 output boundary before any FP8 conversion.
gdn_gated_normalization.choice: Preserve the already repaired native M1 contract. Adding Hugging Face's intermediate BF16 casts would select a different arithmetic target and is not an automatic correctness repair.
gdn_gated_normalization.transcendental_binding: Pinned layernorm_guard.py / Gluon intrinsic implementation; exact real-function equality is not asserted.

gdn_recurrence.qkv: BF16 inputs widened to FP32; Q/K normalization stays FP32
gdn_recurrence.softplus: Stable log1p(exp(x)) for x<=20, x otherwise; x=FP32(a+dt_bias). Never log(1+exp(x)) with a rounded add that cancels small gates.
gdn_recurrence.state: FP32 persistent delta-rule state; causal sequential transitions; retained multiply-add contraction must match the pinned M1 operation
gdn_recurrence.output: BF16_RNE of the output dot product
gdn_recurrence.history: Existing nine-slot layout; physical slots may differ but logical state and accepted-prefix versions must agree
gdn_recurrence.historical_contract: gdn-stock-m1-arithmetic-v1.json records the old unstable-softplus artifact; its old hashes are historical evidence, not the current reference identity.

other_boundaries.projection: Exact decoded stored MXFP4 coefficients and declared FP8 activations; FP32 accumulation, final BF16_RNE. Row folding cannot remove representable coefficients. Reduction-order bit equivalence remains a separately checked obligation.
other_boundaries.convolution: BF16 history and inputs, declared native FP32 convolution/SiLU arithmetic, final BF16 output; rejected rows cannot modify retained history
other_boundaries.rope: Stored frequency construction and position layout are part of the identity; FP32 rotation with corrected BF16_RNE output, untouched nonrotary values exact
other_boundaries.attention: BF16 Q/K operands preserve range; FP32 QK accumulation and post-dot scale; FP32 softmax; high-plus-residual probability/value product; FP32 unnormalised split numerators/denominators; final BF16_RNE. Independent dense FP64 oracle separately quantifies finite-precision error.
other_boundaries.mlp: BF16_RNE(SiLU_FP32(gate)), then BF16_RNE(product with BF16 up); FP8 conversion only after that second boundary
other_boundaries.final_norm: BF16 output; no serving FP8 final norm
other_boundaries.sampler: Explicit temperature/top-k/top-p and mask order; independent proposal and target replacement randomness; distribution checks are statistical, not identical-seed path proofs

conformance_obligations: A row's normalized BF16/FP8 values and scales do not depend on batch partition or unrelated rows.
Independent coefficient reconstruction and full projection-output checks; sampled numerical criteria do not certify arbitrary inputs.
Physical page permutation with the same logical KV sequence preserves attention; padded future values and unreferenced pages are invisible.
Saved state carries its arithmetic identity. A normalization/state change needs a new snapshot namespace before production deployment.
Fresh complete-model M1/M8 and eager/compiled qualification is required after arithmetic changes; historical agreement is not inherited.
Record both original counterexamples and repaired outputs; never widen tolerances to make a failure pass.
